note: DBS Bank (Taiwan)'s personal banking services tariff table (effective 1 October 2025): the account management fee of 500 Taiwan dollars a month falls only on DBS Treasures clients whose total assets drop below its barrier; a general customer's column carries none. Transfer, cheque and withdrawal charges aren't modelled.
